candidate.title: PARE-Seq
candidate.scope: The single PARE-Seq (parallel analysis of RNA ends) workflow in the assigned Illumina poster row, from the illustrated miRNA-directed mRNA cleavage through poly(A) RNA recovery, end-adapter ligation, cDNA synthesis, MmeI tag generation, second-adapter ligation and PCR. The RNA-end tag library reports captured polyadenylated decay intermediates. The leftmost PARE explanatory motif is an identifying illustration, not an additional processing branch. Neighboring NET-seq, mNET-seq and GMUCT 1.0 rows and the right-margin chemical/QR graphic are context, with no connecting workflow arrows to PARE-Seq. PARE is the expanded assay name here, not another alternative target. No separate sequencing or analysis operation is drawn. The matching collection page is secondary schematic evidence; the supplied papers are inspected at abstract level only.
